test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given group of words.**

Restore (someone) to health or normal life after imprisonment, addiction, or illness
solution:
The correct answer is '**rehabilitate**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**rehabilitate**'.
 
• It means **'to help somebody to live a normal life again after an illness, being in prison, etc'.** (अस्‍वस्‍थ होने, क़ैद में रहने आदि के बाद सामान्‍य जीवन बिताने में किसी की सहायता करना)
 
 
• *Example: He's still **rehabilitating** the knee he injured last summer.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *rehabilitate.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Reinstate**: to give back a job or position that was taken from somebody. (किसी को उसके पूर्व पद या नौकरी पर वापस लेना)
 
• **Refurbish**: to clean and decorate a room, building, etc. to make it more beautiful, useful, etc. ((कमरा, ईमारत, आदि) सजाना या मरम्मत करना (सुंदर, उपयोगी आदि बनाने के लिए))
 
• **Renovate**: to repair an old building and put it back into good condition. (पुरानी इमारत की मरम्‍मत कर उसे बढ़िया बना देना, नूतन करना)
